description:
Hushfacebook v0.13.0 targets Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This release gathers everything since v0.12.0 and still brings 91 patches for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54. New switches hide reposts, save the picture behind a photo Story with music, take the Meta AI button out of Chats and keep saves quiet. With Picture-in-picture on, a link that opens while a reel floats brings Facebook back full screen. Link posts leave Home on 582 again, the kept top bar stops fading, and a reel waiting to play starts its bar at the beginning. A failed save says why, Morphe Manager shows this release's whole list of changes, and the Reported issues list below maps each report this release touches.

Built by GitHub Actions from commit 3f9e71f99147, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, build 475417104, or its 32-bit build 475417036. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
